Filed from /rebar-debug Phase 1 (analysis only). Phase 2 (repair) deliberately NOT entered at the operator's instruction — this ticket is the diagnosis work product; no code was changed.

Reproduction + experiment scripts (hermetic, temp git trackers, no writes to the shared store): /tmp/exp-signfence/exp.py (arms A/B — unrelated-churn isolation of the before!=after fence), exp2.py (arm C — isolates the under-lock locked_head!=expected_after clause), exp3.py (site C — 58.4% store-read-failure rate from another writer's locked add->commit staged-index gap). Investigation ran in worktree /Users/joeoakhart/debug-signreview-persist off origin/main; retired after the run.

Legitimacy: defect / incomplete implementation, cited against 790c-a7a3-120a-42c8 AC-1 (closed as met), the PlanReviewGeneration docstring at generation.py:30-46, and tests/unit/test_plan_review_generation_scope.py:1. caused_by attributed to d70a-d06e-aea0-4008 by scope-of-work, diverging deliberately from what git blame reports (5967-4476-7f9f-442d / 94e605a29d, which introduced the fence) — reasoning in the description under 'Defect origin'.

Nothing was written to the shared tracker during the investigation beyond this ticket and its two links.
